from pathlib import Path
from html.parser import HTMLParser
import subprocess
s=Path('index.html').read_text()
js=s.split('<script type=\"module\">',1)[1].split('</script>',1)[0]
p=subprocess.run(['node','--input-type=module','--check'],input=js,text=True,capture_output=True)
assert p.returncode==0,p.stderr
class Page(HTMLParser):
 def __init__(self): super().__init__();self.ids=[];self.views=[];self.rates=[]
 def handle_starttag(self,tag,attrs):
  a=dict(attrs)
  if 'id' in a:self.ids.append(a['id'])
  if 'data-view' in a:self.views.append(a['data-view'])
  if tag=='option':self.rates.append(a['value'])
page=Page();page.feed(s)
assert len(page.ids)==len(set(page.ids))
assert page.views==['top','follow','orbit','impact']
assert page.rates==['0.25','0.5','1','2']
assert 'resetExperiment(DEFAULTS);' in js and 'requestAnimationFrame(animate);' in js
assert \"target?.closest('input,textarea,select,[contenteditable]')\" in js
assert s.startswith('<"'!DOCTYPE html>'"') and s.rstrip().endswith('</html>')
assert [p.name for p in Path('.').iterdir()]==['index.html']
print('PASS: complete-file syntax, unique UI IDs, four views, four speeds, input-focus guard, default auto-start, and index.html-only delivery.')
PY"
